title: GitHub repository default-branch protection state
description: The effective protection of one repository's default branch, merged from classic branch protection and every active ruleset that applies to it. Supersedes github.repo_protection.v1, which reported an unreadable repository's fields as 0 and false, ignored rulesets, and had no stable repository id. A protection field the connector could not read is omitted, never reported as off.

repo_id.description: GitHub's repository id. Stable across renames; checks key on it.

required_reviews.description: The highest required approving review count across classic protection and active rulesets.

enforce_admins.description: A source that requires an approving review binds admins: classic enforce_admins, or a ruleset none of whose bypass actors can be an admin (only an app or a deploy key may bypass). Omitted when that rests on a ruleset whose bypass actors the token can't read.

protection_source.description: Where the branch's protection comes from.

reason.description: Why the connector's verdict is what it is; for an inconclusive record, what could not be read.
